title: A Beginner's Book of the Guandao
summary: A plain first book showing an untrained beginner how to grip balance and swing the guandao using body strength alone.

title: Crescent Blade Footing Drills
summary: A short set of footing drills that teach a skin-hardened student to stand and shift behind a heavy curved blade.

title: The Plain Treatise of the Long Curved Blade
summary: A plain account of cuts and carries for students whose muscle can lift the guandao through a full bout.

title: Pole-Blade Sweeping Exercises for Strong Arms
summary: Exercises that train tendon-strong arms to drive the guandao through wide sweeps without losing the line of the blade.

title: Workbook of the Heavy Crescent
summary: A workbook that sets a bone-hardened student drills on weight transfer and the full range of the heavy crescent blade.

title: Lessons on the Butt Spike and the Long Grip
summary: Short lessons on using the pole's butt spike and sliding the grip to change reach in close quarters.

title: The Curved Blade Qi Primer
summary: A primer for students who have just begun to circulate qi and wish to carry it along the guandao's blade.

title: Guandao Breath and Blade Handbook
summary: A handbook that joins steady breathing to each cut of the guandao for students who already circulate their own qi.

title: Drill-Book of the Crescent Edge
summary: A drill-book of five cutting exercises for new qi circulators who want their blade edge to stay true.

title: A Common Canon of the Long Blade
summary: A canon of eight plain techniques covering cut guard thrust and step for any student with a first reserve of qi.

title: The Pole and Crescent Student's Manual
summary: A student's manual that gathers the safest everyday guandao techniques for those able to channel a thin thread of qi.
